tools.name: flowmap_analyze_workspace
tools.description: Scan an entire codebase and return a full call graph — all functions, their parameters, and all call relationships between them. Use this first when exploring an unfamiliar codebase.

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns to exclude. Defaults: node_modules,dist,.git,__pycache__,*.test.*,*.spec.*

language.description: Filter to a single language: typescript, javascript, python, java, go, rust, tsx, jsx. Omit to scan all.

tools.name: flowmap_analyze_file
tools.description: Scan a single file and return all functions defined in it, their parameters, and calls made within the file.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to analyse

tools.name: flowmap_get_callers
tools.description: Return all functions that directly call the named function. Use this for impact analysis — to understand what breaks if you change a function's signature.

functionName.description: The function name to find callers of

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

tools.name: flowmap_get_callees
tools.description: Return all functions directly called by the named function. Use this to understand what a function depends on.

functionName.description: The function name to find callees of

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

tools.name: flowmap_get_flow
tools.description: Return the complete sub-graph reachable from a given function — every function it calls, every function those call, and so on recursively. Use this to understand the full execution path of a feature or entry point.

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

tools.name: flowmap_list_entry_points
tools.description: Return all detected entry points in the codebase — main functions, HTTP route handlers, React root renders, CLI commands, etc. Always call this first when exploring a new codebase to understand where execution begins.

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

tools.name: flowmap_find_orphans
tools.description: Return all functions that are never called from any entry point — potential dead code. Use this during refactoring to identify code that can safely be removed.

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

tools.name: flowmap_find_cycles
tools.description: Detect all call cycles (circular dependencies / mutual recursion) in the codebase. Returns each cycle as an ordered list of functions that call each other in a loop, along with the exact call edges forming the cycle. Use this to identify architectural problems, infinite-recursion risks, or tightly coupled modules.

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

minCycleLength.description: Minimum number of functions in a cycle to report (default: 1, includes self-recursion)

exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns to exclude. Defaults: node_modules,dist,.git,__pycache__,*.test.*,*.spec.*

tools.name: flowmap_find_duplicates
tools.description: Identify functionally duplicate functions — different names, potentially in different files or components, but calling the same set of dependencies (same business logic). Uses callee-set Jaccard similarity: two functions are flagged as duplicates when the overlap of what they call exceeds the similarity threshold. Results are grouped into clusters so you can see when 3+ functions are all doing the same thing. Use this to find refactoring opportunities and candidates for a shared utility. Default thresholds can be tuned via FLOWMAP_DUP_THRESHOLD and FLOWMAP_DUP_MIN_CALLEES environment variables.

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

similarityThreshold.description: Jaccard similarity threshold (0–1). Default: 0.75 (or FLOWMAP_DUP_THRESHOLD env var). Lower = more matches, higher = stricter. 1.0 = identical callee sets.

minCallees.description: Minimum number of distinct callees a function must have to be considered. Default: 2 (or FLOWMAP_DUP_MIN_CALLEES env var). Raising this avoids matching trivial one-liner wrappers.

exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns to exclude. Defaults: node_modules,dist,.git,__pycache__,*.test.*,*.spec.*
